verdict.rationale: Vue's Single-File Components combine template (HTML), script (JS), and style (CSS) in one file, and this is directly evidenced by docs (builds on standard HTML/CSS/JS) plus strong community corroboration praising SFCs for separating/combining concerns cleanly (vue-comm-9, vue-comm-13). Missing for 10: no direct first-party doc citation quoting the SFC spec itself, only general framework description docs.
